# Women Fiber to Fashion — wf2f.in

Static marketing site for a garment manufacturer in New Delhi. Live at
https://wf2f.in via GitHub Pages, branch deploy from `main` (no Actions
workflow of our own). Plain HTML/CSS/JS — no framework, no build step at
deploy time.

## The two rules that matter most

**1. Never edit the root `*.html` files.** All six are generated by
`scripts/build.py`. A direct edit looks like it worked and is silently
overwritten by the next build. Edit the page content in `scripts/build.py`,
then rebuild. A PreToolUse hook enforces this.

**2. Use `/usr/bin/python3`, not `python3`.** PIL is installed on the system
Python only; Homebrew's is a different interpreter without it. The generator
is also written for Python 3.9 — **f-strings cannot contain backslashes**, and
`%`-formatted template strings need `%%` for a literal percent.

```bash
/usr/bin/python3 scripts/build.py      # regenerate all pages + sitemap.xml
/usr/bin/python3 scripts/logos.py      # regenerate client logos (arg: ink hex)
```

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `scripts/build.py` | **The source of truth.** Page content, nav, schema, chrome |
| `scripts/logos.py` | Client-logo pipeline, re-runnable at any ink colour |
| `scripts/dims.json` | Every image's dimensions — **must stay in sync** |
| `assets/css/styles.css` | Hand-written, edit directly |
| `assets/js/main.js` | Hand-written, edit directly |
| `assets/img/` | Web-ready output only |
| `assets/Website images/` | Original photography — **gitignored, local only** |
| `*.html`, `sitemap.xml` | Generated. Do not edit |

## Images

Naming: `ap-NN` apparel, `hm-NN` home & accessories, `fac-*` factory, `hero`.
Every image ships as a `.jpg` and a `.webp`; `<picture>` serves WebP first, so
**syncing only `.jpg` leaves the browser on a stale WebP**.

`scripts/dims.json` must be updated whenever an image is reprocessed. Width and
height attributes come from it, and drift reintroduces layout shift.

Before committing new imagery, check for:

- **Edge bands** — a thin uniform strip that *ends* with a sharp tonal jump.
  Supplied sources (especially WhatsApp) often have them baked in. A uniform
  run that continues to the scan cap is the seamless backdrop, not a band.
- **Clipping** — anything over ~8% pure black or ~6% pure white.

Both checks have produced false positives before. A dark garment reaching the
frame edge is not a band; verify the profile before cropping.

## Palette

Canvas `#F7F4EF` · card `#EFECE6` · ink `#1F1E1C` · muted `#5A5854` ·
sage CTA `#3B483B` (hover `#2E392E`) · terracotta `#B06D53`.

**Terracotta is 3.71:1 — large text only.** Use it for the metric figures and
borders, never for links or small labels. Re-verify every pairing on both the
canvas *and* the card tone after any palette change; several candidates pass on
white and fail on the tint.

## Content facts

MOQ 100 pieces · 12,000–15,000 pieces/month · 50+ machines · inline, mid-line
and final QC · markets USA, Europe, Australia & NZ, Middle East, India.

The positioning is **not** women-led — that framing was removed deliberately.
The workforce facts stay but argue commercially (retention as quality
consistency, training as capability). Certifications are omitted by the
owner's instruction.

## Deploy

`git push origin main`. Pages rebuilds in roughly 30–60 seconds; the CDN then
takes another poll or two, so verify with `curl` rather than assuming.
GitHub itself commits to this repo when the custom domain changes in Settings —
pull before pushing if the domain was touched.
